name: @arcade/solitaire
description: Type-safe Solitaire in React + Vite + TypeScript — Klondike (draw 1 / draw 3), Spider (1, 2 or 4 suits) and FreeCell (Microsoft deal numbers) with drag and drop, click-to-move, full keyboard play, hints, undo, auto-complete, safe auto-moves to the foundations, autosave & resume, dental mode and English / Hungarian / German. Part of Arcade-Game-Center.
